gen-dafont-nasalization-fs-nunito: Nasalization floats its wide-set letters apart, with short ascenders and a c opened like calipers, while Nunito rounds everything off. Body text around 16px would feel right.
gen-dafont-nasalization-fs-pilcrow-round: Pilcrow Rounded reads soft and snug, its sans letters packed close with curves that never quite close up. Nasalization above it is the loose, spaced-out one, and that gap is the charm.
gen-dafont-nasalization-fs-quicksand: Friendly all the way down, from the spaced heading to the body. Quicksand's tall, bulb-round lowercase has the same lightness, so a size slightly above default lets those glassy bowls breathe.
gen-dafont-neuropol-fs-chillax: Neuropol looks like a digital outline, closed up tight with only a slim channel where the c opens. Chillax begins loosely where it leaves its loops unfinished, so the two feel like machine and doodle sharing a page.
gen-dafont-neuropol-plus-jakarta-sans: Futuristic and boxed in, Neuropol keeps its letters closed like a single-weight outline. Plus Jakarta Sans then lets its curves end well apart, so a long stretch of text feels modern, precise and easy to move through.
gen-dafont-neuropol-sora: Neuropol is all sci-fi outline, with a slim channel where its c opens. And Sora, geometric and precise, keeps its c and s widely parted, so longer text moves along smoothly with no swelling at the curves.
gen-dafont-neuropol-space-grotesk: Think control-panel readout: Neuropol is digital and futuristic, its c barely opened by a slim channel. Space Grotesk fills the page beneath with hollow, breathing counters, so the closed heading and open sans text complement each other.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-fs-alpino: Neuropolitical looks like neon tubing with its letters pulled apart, every line the same glowing thickness. Alpino, tall and cozy, packs its spacing tight and keeps curve endings apart, making the contrast the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-fs-familjen-gr: Neuropolitical sets its words apart letter by letter, with a bent-pipe-cleaner texture and big open counters in every small letter. Its heading does glow and spread, while Familjen Grotesk stays lively and compact for the text.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-fs-hind: Geometric and contemporary, Neuropolitical lays out neon-tube letters pulled apart with big open counters in the lowercase. It earns its keep big and short, while Hind simply does the quiet work below.
